name: High Priest of the Astringentum
biography:
Entominid clypeum. A Formigan entomorph cleric of the Astringentum, the theocracy of metal-haters — the dish-like crown atop its head holds a pool of blessed acid it pours out to bless allies or dissolve armour. Its Speed is 25 ft. while the Caustic Pool is filled. Habitat: Any.

Gear: Staff.

features.name: Caustic Pool
features.description:
As long as the high priest's acid pool is filled, it gains the following effects:

  • Its Speed is reduced by 5 feet.
  • It has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
  • It regains 2 (1d4) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns.
  • A creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 2 (1d4) Acid damage.

features.name: Toppled Dish
features.description: When the high priest is knocked Prone, the acid in its dish spills, emptying it, and each creature within 5 feet of the high priest takes 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ability: Wisdom; DC: 16; Modifier: +8. The high priest uses its Staff as a spellcasting focus.

At Will: Acid Splash (level 5 caster)

4/Day: Acid Arrow, Acid Rain* (C), Heat Metal (C)

1/Day: Nomi's Adamantine Carapace* (cast before combat)

*See the spell pages of the Field Notes PDF; (C) indicates Concentration.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The high priest makes two Staff attacks.

features.name: Staff
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

features.name: Outpouring of Blessings
features.description: The high priest empties its acid pool, pouring it out onto a willing creature within 5 feet of it. Until the end of the high priest's next turn, the creature is blessed: it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and has Advantage on attack rolls. In addition, any creature without Resistance or Immunity to Acid damage that moves to a space within 30 feet of the blessed creature for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is unable to willingly move closer to the blessed creature.

features.name: Outpouring of Pain
features.description: The high priest empties its acid pool, pouring it out onto an enemy. Saving Throw: DC 16 Dexterity, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Acid damage, and any nonmagical metal objects the target is wearing or carrying begin to rust. Metal armour and Shields take a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC they provide, and metal weapons take a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to attack and damage rolls. An armour reduced to an AC of 10, a Shield reduced to a bonus of +0, or a weapon with a penalty of -5 is destroyed. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Acrid Fountain
features.description: The high priest refills its acid pool. It can't take this Bonus Action if it's Prone.
